data.body: Operator decision: option A approved with a load-bearing coordination requirement. The live reconciler is GitHub Actions Reconcile Bridge. Do not clean Jira independently and allow it to run against stale local history. The prepared execution sequence must disable reconcile-bridge.yml, prove disabled_manually plus no queued/in-progress pass, freeze and back up both systems, delete the exact six rollout-created Jira IDs, remove their local COMMENT identities together with the manifest-enumerated non-survivor echo history/snapshots, verify both sides and replace persistent clones, then re-enable only after non-resurrection checks. Preparation remains nonmutating; the expanded description/file-impact/verify commands record the dry-run-default cleanup tool and coordinated runbook scope.
